name: Eriro
beschreibung:
Perched in pristine seclusion above Ehrwald, Eriro presents an extraordinary hideaway for discerning nature enthusiasts. Suites crafted with natural timbers and stone afford utmost privacy and unobstructed views of the Zugspitze massif.

Set amidst alpine terrain, guests enjoy bespoke mountain guiding, exquisite culinary creations, and direct access to hiking and skiing within the Tyrolean Zugspitz Arena.
kurzbeschreibung: The exclusive retreat Eriro in Ehrwald offers secluded mountain immersion and refined alpine luxury facing the Tyrolean Zugspitze.
